drmfrp.options.title: Don't Reload My Resource Packs
drmfrp.options.enabled.tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off. When off, resource packs load exactly as in vanilla.
drmfrp.options.preloadLastServerPacks.to: Loads the last server's packs together with the game at startup, so the first join does not need a second reload. Applies at the next launch.
drmfrp.options.zipIndex.tooltip: Lists files in zip resource packs from an index built once per reload, instead of reading the whole zip for every lookup. Same result, much faster reloads.
drmfrp.options.packCache.tooltip: Keeps the atlases and models of recently visited servers' packs, so going back to one of them does not rebuild them.
drmfrp.options.packCacheSize.tooltip: How many other servers' packs to keep. Each one uses about 40 MB of video memory.
drmfrp.options.earlyApply.tooltip: While a server's pack downloads, shows the copy already on disk. The download still runs; if the pack changed, it is loaded when the download ends.
